title: Credit Utilization Above Target
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:account
| stats latest(balance_usd) as balance_usd, latest(limit_usd) as limit_usd by card_name
| eval utilization_pct=round(100*balance_usd/limit_usd,1)
| where limit_usd>0 AND utilization_pct>30
| sort - utilization_pct
description: Uses Plaid credit-account balances telemetry to monitor current utilization on revolving accounts in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cards that are drifting into more expensive or score-unfriendly territory, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid credit-account balances data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Card table of credit utilization percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It lists current utilization on revolving accounts so you can spot cards that are drifting into more expensive or score-unfriendly territory before it becomes annoying.
